### EC2Conditions <a name="EC2Conditions" id="@cdk_utils/iam.ec2.EC2Conditions"></a>

Condition key constants and builders for ec2.

#### Initializers <a name="Initializers" id="@cdk_utils/iam.ec2.EC2Conditions.Initializer"></a>
